stealth.description: Local Invisible Playwright stealth Firefox running in the Pi Docker backend. Use for browser tasks where ordinary Chromium is likely to hit anti-bot verification.

scrapling.description: Web fetching and structured extraction with a no-Docker anti-bot fallback. Use stealthy_fetch (headless=false, solve_cloudflare=true) only for public pages the user is allowed to access, after a normal fetch is blocked by a challenge.
